mapper.select: SELECT p.plan_item_id, p.plan_id, p.place_id, p.sequence_order, p.transport_mode, p.estimated_duration, h.place_name, h.overview, a.first_image1, a.latitude, a.longitude FROM plan_item p JOIN hotplace h ON p.place_id = h.place_id LEFT JOIN attractions a ON h.place_id = a.content_id WHERE p.plan_item_id = #{planItemId}

SELECT p.plan_item_id, p.plan_id, p.place_id, p.sequence_order, p.transport_mode, p.estimated_duration, h.place_name, h.overview, a.first_image1, a.latitude, a.longitude FROM plan_item p JOIN hotplace h ON p.place_id = h.place_id LEFT JOIN attractions a ON h.place_id = a.content_id ORDER BY p.plan_id, p.sequence_order

SELECT p.plan_item_id, p.plan_id, p.place_id, p.sequence_order, p.transport_mode, p.estimated_duration, h.place_name, h.overview, a.first_image1, a.latitude, a.longitude FROM plan_item p JOIN hotplace h ON p.place_id = h.place_id LEFT JOIN attractions a ON h.place_id = a.content_id WHERE p.plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY p.sequence_order
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO plan_item (plan_id, place_id, sequence_order, transport_mode, estimated_duration) VALUES (#{planId}, #{placeId}, #{sequenceOrder}, #{transportMode}, #{estimatedDuration})
